title: Spiritual Gifts
definition: Spiritual gifts are grace-given abilities from God for serving others and building up the body of Christ.
summary: Spiritual gifts are given for service, love, and the strengthening of the Church.
christFocus: Christ gives gifts to His body through the Spirit so the Church may mature and serve faithfully.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Spiritual gifts are given by God's grace for the good of others. They are not proof of personal superiority or tools for self-promotion. They are entrusted to believers so the Church may be built up in love.

Every believer has a place in the body of Christ. The Church needs many kinds of service, encouragement, teaching, mercy, leadership, generosity, and help. No one has every gift, and no gift should be despised.

Love governs the use of gifts. Gifts without love become noise, pride, or division. Gifts used in humility strengthen the body and glorify Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Churches suffer when believers either bury their gifts or use them selfishly. This doctrine matters because it calls every believer to serve while keeping Christ and love at the center.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask how God has equipped you to serve the body. Use your gifts faithfully, humbly, and lovingly. Do not compare your role to someone else's, and do not confuse visibility with value.
